interpretation.misses: The p95 end-to-end frame interval misses the configured budget in dense-520, local, and world-1023 at both quality settings. Dense-520 low also misses the 100 ms pointer-feedback budget; dense-520 normal meets the 75 ms pointer-feedback budget. Fresh and populated meet both budgets at both settings.
interpretation.cpuAndRendererLimit: The measured synchronous JavaScript render-call p95 is below 40 ms low and 20 ms normal in every scenario, including dense-520. In local and world-1023, the much longer frame intervals occur alongside render-call p95 below 2 ms. This establishes that the interval delays are outside the measured JavaScript render-call duration; this headless SwiftShader run does not attribute them to a specific browser, scheduling, graphics-driver, or GPU cause.
interpretation.memoryLimit: Both Chromium heap growth checks pass the 10 MiB plateau gate. Renderer texture/decoded byte estimates are included for context; these are not driver VRAM measurements.
interpretation.targetDevice: Intel UHD 620 validation remains outstanding. No production optimization or quality change is justified by this artifact alone; changes must preserve scene semantics and show measured end-to-end benefit on relevant hardware.
